tagline: A forward-thinking bank with strong risk management serving commercial and consumer customers
hero_kpi_rationale: Key measure of success for financial institutions, representing the difference between interest income on earning assets and interest expense on interest-bearing liabilities

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the difference between interest received on assets and interest paid on liabilities
kpis.description: Primary revenue source for banks, difference between interest income and interest expense

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total assets held by the bank
kpis.description: Total assets of the bank as of December 31, 2025

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.description: Total deposits of the bank as of December 31, 2025

kpis.name: Total Loans and Leases
kpis.explanation: Loans and lease receivables net of allowance for credit losses
kpis.description: Loans and lease receivables net of allowance for credit losses as of December 31, 2025

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income and interest expense relative to average earning assets
kpis.description: Key measure of profitability on earning assets

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is high due to the company's significant exposure to commercial and real estate loans, which are more sensitive to adverse economic conditions and fluctuations in the commercial real estate market.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Market conditions, such as interest rates and financial market volatility, can negatively impact the company, particularly during periods of declining interest rates.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulatory requirements regarding capital ratios, liquidity reserves, and credit risk management standards, which may limit its operational flexibility.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to liquidity risk due to its reliance on deposits and short-term funding, despite its currently strong liquidity position.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to reputation risk due to its broad banking activities and business decisions, which could affect customer and regulator confidence.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to cybersecurity risk due to its reliance on computer systems, digital banking operations, and Banking-as-a-Service offerings to fintechs.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to geopolitical risk due to military conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East, affecting commodity prices and supply chains.

ai_positioning.summary: CUBI does not have significant mentions of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from the 10-K/20-F filing.
